	<ResortReportHeadline>Fun turns and improving weather.</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>The temperature cooled overnight and it's a little crunchy underfoot this morning, but I expect it'll soften in many zones as the day warms.&nbsp; The current temp is minus 1.2, heading for a top of 3 degrees. The wind is a light to moderate westerly, which is meant to ease further during the day. There's a little fog in the village right now, but the forecast is calling for it to clear up as the day progresses... so it should turn out pretty nice out there.&nbsp;</p><p>Heavenly Valley area is not perfect but there will be plenty of fun turns to be had for advanced and expert skiers and riders.&nbsp; Just take notice of the signage, as some zones runs are upgraded, or may be closed if it's too slick.</p><p>The Extreme Area remains closed due to a significant sliding hazard and please don't attempt to retrieve dropped equipment from closed areas.</p><p>WRX First Tracks is scheduled for Road Runner from 7:30am.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>It's pretty slick in the carparks, so take care while walking around this morning.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Cheers Bill.&nbsp;</p></ResortReport>
